sre-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT (SEV2) - us-central-1 embed-store IO saturation causing elevated 5xx and 429s for embedding reads. Early impact estimate: ~7% of embedding requests, higher tail latency for batch reads. Investigating.

ashley (oncall): taking this. paging storage + infra. I can see read IO queue depth spike at 04:12 UTC and client retries piling up.

ryan (storage): noticed increased compaction/prefetch IO overlap on hot shards; disk_iops util at 93% on embed-node-5. Suspect background prefetch job combined with several large PLG batched reads.

mina (support): CS reports multiple PLG apps and two enterprise customers seeing frequent 429s. Drafting customer note and preparing status link.

infra-bot: ```
# kubectl -n embed-store top pod embed-node-5 --containers
NAME         CPU(cores)   MEMORY(bytes)   DISK_IO
embed-node-5 2100m        6.8Gi           iops=9300
```

ashley (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) pause non-critical background prefetch/compaction jobs in us-central, 2) enable read-rate shaping for PLG clients, 3) failover reads for enterprise customers to warm replicas in us-east-1 while we stabilize. Executing step 1 now.

ryan (storage): paused prefetch and compaction on affected nodes. initiating replica failover for flagged enterprise tenants.

infra-bot: replica failover executed for tenant-a and tenant-b; redirected reads to us-east-1-replica-pool. Observed immediate drop in IOPS on embed-node-5 from 9.3k -> 2.1k.

status-bot: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/210111 - "Investigating elevated embedding errors and throttles in us-central-1. Mitigations in progress."

mina (support): customer comms sent to impacted customers. Two customers requested eta and a postmortem. Noted.

ashley (oncall): enabling soft rate-shaping for anonymous/PLG API keys: limit=50rps per-key, burst=100, backoff for 429s. Canary enabled for 10% of PLG traffic.

infra-bot: canary metrics after 90s: plg_throttle_rps 000->50, embed_429_rate_canary 8.7% -> 1.1%, overall embed_5xx_cluster 7.2% -> 1.5%.

ryan (storage): starting staged rollout of throttling and prefetch pause to remaining nodes: 25% -> 60% -> 100% with 2m observation windows. If we see >2% 5xx we pause and escalate.

mina (support): status page updated: "Mitigation in progress; partial recovery observed. Enterprise failovers in place. Contact enterprise@redwood.ai for urgent support."

ashley (oncall): after second phase, aggregate embedding 429/5xx dropped to 0.8%. Disk IO normalized. continuing verification for 15m.

ryan (storage): root cause hypothesis: prefetch/compaction scheduling allowed high-concurrency IO alongside large client batch reads which exhausted node IO capacity. No protection existed for hot shard IO spikes.

ashley (oncall): action items: add IO-budgeting/cgroup limits for background jobs, implement adaptive prefetch backoff when client IO latency rises, add per-tenant read throttling hooks in embed-proxy, and schedule maintenance to redistribute hot shards.

cs-lead: notified affected enterprise customers about mitigations, failover, and plan for postmortem. Two customers requested timeline for permanent fix; we'll include in RCA.

status-bot: Incident update posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/210111 - "Partial mitigation observed; engineering verification ongoing."

ashley (oncall): RESOLVED: Mitigations completed and verified at 2026-11-08T04:44:48Z. Embedding errors and 429s returned to baseline. Creating RCA thread and action tracker for the items above. :white_check_mark:
